lines.text: The Midianites and Amalekites camped in the Valley of Jezreel, so Gideon blew the ram's horn and rallied the Abiezrites.
Gideon tested God with a fleece, first asking for dew only on the fleece, then asking for the fleece alone to be dry.
The LORD reduced the army from ten thousand men to three hundred, the men who lapped the water with their hands.
Gideon went down with his servant Purah and heard a man describe a dream about a loaf of barley bread.
The men of Ephraim captured the waters of the Jordan and killed Oreb at the rock of Oreb.
